title: DeepSeek’s Token Use on OpenRouter’s API Tops 4 Rivals Combined
summary:
The volume of AI requests handled by DeepSeek outperformed the collective throughput of Google, Anthropic, xAI and OpenAI during the final seven days of September. This activity occurred on OpenRouter, a unified API gateway that allows developers to access and compare multiple large language models from different providers through a single interface.

Social Capital first reported the figures, and Peter Walker of OpenRouter confirmed the usage statistics on the platform. The results show a shift in adoption toward DeepSeek's models relative to the leading providers in the AI market for the specified period.
